title: Practitioner Profile
subtitle: Manage the account details and credentials tied to your ilovelawyer workspace.

accountInformation.heading: Account Information
accountInformation.subheading: The identity details visible across your workspace.

fullName.label: Full Name
fullName.genericError: Failed to save. Please try again.

username.label: Username
username.tooShortError: Username must be at least 3 characters.
username.invalidCharsError: Only letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens are allowed.
username.genericError: Failed to save. Please try again.

security.heading: Security
security.subheading: Session and sign-in activity for this account.
security.signOutDescription: Ends your current session and returns you to the login screen.

changePassword.rowDescription: Update the password you use to sign in.
changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.description: Enter your current password and choose a new one. You'll stay signed in on this device.
changePassword.cancelTooltip: Discard changes and close this dialog

yourData.heading: Your Data
yourData.subheading: A copy of the personal data we hold about you.

download.title: Download my data
download.description: A zip with a readable PDF summary, the complete record in a data file, and the files you uploaded. Cases and documents that belong to an organization you don't own are not included.
download.confirmDescription: We'll prepare a zip with a PDF summary of what we hold about you, the complete record, and the files you uploaded. It can take a minute for larger accounts. Keep this tab open until the download starts.
download.passwordHint: Enter the password you use to sign in. This keeps your data private if someone else has your device.

aiProcessing.title: AI processing
aiProcessing.description: AI is part of how ilovelawyer works and is on by default under our Terms of Service. It covers chat, the analysis tools on your cases and the automatic analysis after you upload. Switch it off and these stop working until you switch it back on.
aiProcessing.error: We couldn't save that. Please try again.
aiProcessing.confirmDescription: AI features will stop working for your account:
aiProcessing.confirmChat: Chat won't reply to new messages.
aiProcessing.confirmCase: Refresh analysis and every Generate button on your cases will be refused.
aiProcessing.confirmUpload: Documents you upload won't be analysed automatically.
aiProcessing.confirmUndo: You can switch it back on here at any time.

aiConsentPrompt.title: AI on ilovelawyer
aiConsentPrompt.body: ilovelawyer uses AI on your cases and documents to analyse them, answer your questions and help you draft. Under our Terms of Service this is on by default, and by using the platform you agree to it.
aiConsentPrompt.ifOff: If you switch it off, chat, Refresh analysis and every Generate button stop working until you switch it back on.
aiConsentPrompt.change: You can change this at any time in Profile > Your Data.

dangerZone.heading: Danger Zone
dangerZone.subheading: Irreversible and destructive actions for this account.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Schedules your account for deletion and signs you out. You can restore it by signing in again within 30 days. After that, your account and all associated data are permanently deleted.
deleteAccount.confirmDescription: Your account will be scheduled for deletion and you'll be signed out on every device. You can restore it by signing in again within 30 days. After that, your account and all associated data are permanently deleted and this cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.passwordHint: Enter the password you use to sign in to confirm this deletion.
deleteAccount.scheduledDescription: Your account and all associated data will be permanently deleted on {{date}}.
deleteAccount.successDescription: Your account and all associated data will be permanently deleted on {{date}}. You've been signed out. To restore your account, just sign in again before then.

avatar.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
avatar.tooLarge: Choose an image of 2 MB or less.
avatar.wrongType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
avatar.genericError: Couldn't update your photo. Please try again.

googleCalendar.title: Google Calendar
googleCalendar.connectedDescription: Connected. Appointments sync both ways: changes here show in Google Calendar, and title, time and note edits made there come back within a few minutes.
googleCalendar.disconnectedDescription: Connect a Google account to sync your appointments with its Google Calendar, both ways. This doesn't change how you sign in.
googleCalendar.popupError: Google didn't complete the connection. Please try again.
googleCalendar.genericError: Couldn't update Google Calendar. Please try again.

clientRequests.heading: Take on new clients
clientRequests.subheading: Clients on ilovelawyer.com ask for a lawyer for their case. Once your registration is verified, requests that match your practice areas come to you. You see an anonymised summary first and pay a fixed fee only when a client confirms you.
clientRequests.loadError: Couldn't load your client request settings. Refresh to try again.

statusHelp.UNSUBMITTED: Apply once with your regulator and registration number. We check them against the register, usually within a working day.
statusHelp.PENDING: We're checking your registration with your regulator. This usually takes a working day, and we'll email you when it's done.
statusHelp.REJECTED: We couldn't verify your registration. Correct your details and resubmit to have them checked again.

clientRequests.incomplete: Your application isn't finished. Still needed: {{fields}}.

accepting.title: Accept client requests
accepting.description: New requests that match your practice areas and jurisdictions reach you while this is on.
accepting.offByOrganization: Your organization has turned client requests off for you.
accepting.tooltip: Turn new client requests on or off

dialog.description: We check your registration against your regulator's register, usually within a working day. Client requests start once it's approved.
dialog.recheckWarning: Changing your regulator, registration number or jurisdictions sends your application back for review. New client requests stop until it's approved again.
dialog.submitted: Application submitted. We'll email you once we've checked your registration.

areas.personalInjuryWhy: Referral fees aren't allowed in personal injury cases, so we can't send these.

fields.registrationNumberHelp: Your SRA number, or your Law Society of Scotland or Northern Ireland number.
fields.bioHelp: Shown to a client when you send them a quote.
fields.languagesHelp: The languages you can work with clients in.
fields.languagesPlaceholder: Type a language, then press Enter
fields.feeHelp: Leave empty if you don't offer one.
fields.pausedUntilHelp: No new requests until this date. Leave empty to stay on.
